summary: Circle Internet Group disclosed a definitive Share Purchase Agreement, through indirect subsidiary Taurus Acquisition Inc., to acquire all outstanding shares of Singapore-based Tazapay Pte. Ltd. not already held. Aggregate consideration is $400,000,000 in Circle Class A stock, adjusted for unpaid debt, transaction expenses and target cash, divided by the 20-trading-day VWAP ending immediately before closing. Closing consideration is cut by a 5% indemnity holdback and an additional 3% holdback. Sellers Representative is Fortis Advisors. Mechanics hinge on a floating exchange ratio, so Circle's share price around closing drives dilution and any overhang; watch regulatory clearances and closing conditions.
